name: UI State & State Presentation
description: UI State & State Presentation standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-UI-STATE applies.

rules.title: Model meaningful UI states explicitly
rules.detail: A data-driven screen/component distinguishes initial, loading, success/data, empty, refreshing, validation error, business/system error and other applicable states rather than one boolean loading flag.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Model meaningful UI states explicitly.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Model meaningful UI states explicitly.

rules.title: Distinguish initial loading from refresh
rules.detail: Refreshing existing data should normally preserve useful content and indicate background progress instead of replacing the whole screen with a blocking loader.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Distinguish initial loading from refresh.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Distinguish initial loading from refresh.

rules.title: Treat empty as a successful state
rules.detail: No-data results use an intentional empty state with context/action where useful; they are not rendered as an error.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Treat empty as a successful state.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Treat empty as a successful state.

rules.title: Represent offline and stale data explicitly when supported
rules.detail: When cached data is shown without confirmed connectivity/freshness, communicate stale/offline state and available recovery behavior.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Represent offline and stale data explicitly when supported.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Represent offline and stale data explicitly when supported.

rules.title: Keep validation, business and technical errors distinct
rules.detail: The UI renders each error class with the appropriate scope and action instead of collapsing all failures into one generic toast.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep validation, business and technical errors distinct.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep validation, business and technical errors distinct.

rules.title: Make state transitions deterministic and testable
rules.detail: Async completion from obsolete requests must not overwrite newer state; critical state transitions have automated tests or equivalent evidence.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make state transitions deterministic and testable.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make state transitions deterministic and testable.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-UI-STATE applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of UI State & State Presentation to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Everything is represented by isLoading + error string
common_issues.cause: State model is too coarse to represent refresh, empty, stale, validation and business errors.
common_issues.solution: Introduce explicit state variants and transition tests.

common_issues.issue: Old request overwrites newer UI data
common_issues.cause: Concurrent async work is not correlated or cancelled.
common_issues.solution: Use request identity/cancellation and accept results only for the current intent.
